answers.perfect_saturday: In the morning I like to be active, go for a run or spend time outside. If available Id love to swim or find a place to lounge. Then in the afternoon Id like to go to a day party with my friends. Spend a few hours dancing and drinking, then go to a nice dinner. After dinner Id love to turn in for a game night or movie
answers.arrival_instinct: Probably go grab a coffee and pastry or a beer. Alternatively Id check out major nearby sights/monuments that dont require much time but are must sees.
answers.the_table: I love to order things I couldnt get anywhere else and maybe have never heard of. I tend to stay away from slimey things and uncommon meats. I like roasted vegetables and braised meat. I also love seafood. Its likely several items that Im sharing with the table. I also have a beer or cocktail to go with.
answers.one_splurge: It might be a private excursion or guided trip to see a unique sight
answers.overrated: Ziplines or other light thrills. Give me a rush or let me relax.
answers.worth_it_moment: I love mountains and anytime Im isolated in nature with a majestic view I realize how small my problems are. I also love the feeling of distance from the rest of the world. Seeing a wild animal is also always a reminder of how many things exist and happen that we will never connect with,
answers.pace_instinct: Definetly depends on what we've done, what they're suggestion, and if theres more time in the itinerary tomorrow. Id generally find the energy but if its overly intensive or boring I will object and prefer resting.
answers.hotel_first_ten: View and Bathroom are likely the most important aspects. If theres a balcony thats a huge plus. We look for something clean and well lit. If theres free snacks/drinks thats nice to have. I definitely want the bed to be clean and comfortable but most standard hotel beds are fine.
answers.romanticized_place: Madagascar is the top of my bucketlist because I imagine the nature is amazing and cant be seen elsewhere
answers.depth_vs_breadth:
B
I like to maximize experiences especially in places I likely wont return to
